title: Shattered Covenant
brief: Original-IP 3d-open-world-souls game (sub-genre: 3d-open-world-souls). Capture the core mechanics and game-feel of "Elden Ring" (critically acclaimed, 96%) — but with your OWN original name, theme, characters and art. Do NOT reference or reuse that title's IP. design_doc.title: Shattered Covenant
design_doc.core_loop: The player explores a vast, interconnected dying world as a Forsworn warrior seeking fragments of a broken divine pact. Combat is deliberate and punishing: stamina-based melee attacks, timed blocks, dodge-rolls with i-frames, and spell-casting require careful resource management. Death returns the player to the last sanctum (checkpoint) with lost essence (currency/xp) recoverable at death location. Defeating bosses yields covenant shards that unlock new traversal abilities (double-jump, wall-run, spirit-dash) and expand accessible regions. Progression is non-linear: player chooses which domain to tackle based on difficulty and reward signals.

IN: 3 major domains (forest/ruins/volcano) each with unique boss
8-12 enemy types with distinct attack patterns
Stamina-based combat with light/heavy attacks, dodge-roll i-frames, parry window
Death mechanic: drop essence at death location, one chance to recover
5 sanctums (checkpoints) that restore health/flasks and respawn enemies
Spirit steed mount for overworld traversal
3 covenant shards unlocking double-jump, wall-run, spirit-dash
10+ consumables (health flask, stamina flask, cure poison, buff items)
Dynamic weather and day/night cycle affecting enemy behavior
Boss health bars, player HUD (health/stamina/essence counter)
OUT: Quest log (implicit objectives via world design)

art_direction.palette: Desaturated earth tones (ochre, charcoal, rust) with accent pops of ethereal cyan for covenant energy and crimson for blood/danger. Sky gradients shift from bruised purple at dawn to sickly amber at dusk.
art_direction.mood: Melancholic grandeur. Crumbling gothic architecture overgrown with bioluminescent fungi. Monolithic statues of forgotten gods. Mist and volumetric lighting create oppressive atmosphere. Enemy designs blend corrupted nature (twisted roots, obsidian shells) with fractured holy iconography.
art_direction.references: Beksinski's decayed landscapes, Bloodborne's Victorian horror, Shadow of the Colossus scale

milestone_plan.M1: VERTICAL SLICE (Week 1-2): Single combat arena with 1 basic enemy type, player can light attack/heavy attack/dodge-roll/block, stamina drains and regenerates, death resets to arena start, readable HUD shows health/stamina bars. Settings menu with volume/difficulty functional.
milestone_plan.M2: CORE MECHANICS (Week 3-4): Lock-on system, parry timing window, 3 weapon types with different move-sets, spell-casting with mana cost, leveling UI (allocate stats at sanctum), death drops essence recoverable once, 3 enemy types with telegraphed attacks, first boss fight with phase transition at 50% health.
milestone_plan.M3: CONTENT EXPANSION (Week 5-7): All 3 domains playable with interconnected shortcuts, 8 enemy types, 3 full boss encounters, spirit steed mount, sanctum fast-travel, covenant shards unlock traversal abilities, full armor/weapon variety, consumable inventory system, minimap with fog-of-war.
milestone_plan.M4: POLISH & BALANCE (Week 8-9): Particle effects for hits/spells/death, sound design pass (footsteps/weapon swings/ambient wind), boss AI tuning, difficulty scaling tested across all 3 settings, tutorial sanctum with learn-by-doing prompts, enemy placement/difficulty curve validated, performance optimization (60fps target).
milestone_plan.M5: SHIP PREP (Week 10): Final bug sweep, how-to-play screen with control diagrams, win state (defeat final boss â†’ covenant restored cutscene card), lose state (run out of essence â†’ permadeath option on brutal mode), pause menu fully functional, fullscreen toggle, credits screen, build packaging and smoke test on target platforms.

definition_of_done: Player can complete a full run from title screen to final boss defeat in 45-90 minutes
All 3 difficulty modes balanced: story (forgiving stamina/damage), normal (as designed), brutal (limited sanctums + permadeath)
Death mechanic functions: essence drops, minimap shows corpse marker, recovery or permanent loss on second death
Lock-on targeting smoothly switches between enemies within camera view
Parry window is 0.2s with visual/audio feedback, successful parry staggers enemy for riposte
All 3 bosses have unique movesets with 5+ attacks and phase transitions
Covenant shards unlock traversal: double-jump at 33% progression, wall-run at 66%, spirit-dash at final boss
Settings persist: difficulty/volume/control bindings save and reload
HUD is readable at 1080p: health/stamina bars, essence counter, equipped weapon/spell icons, minimap, boss health bar during encounters
No softlocks: player can always return to sanctum via death or fast-travel after unlocking multiple sanctums
Spirit steed mount increases movement speed 2x, dismounts on combat initiation
Win state shows 'Covenant Restored' card with total playtime and death count
Lose state (brutal permadeath) shows 'Forsworn Forever' card with option to restart or quit
Tutorial sanctum teaches combat via environmental prompts (stone tablets) for attack/dodge/parry/spell within first 5 minutes
Audio: distinct SFX for each weapon type, spell school, enemy hit/death, ambient loops per domain, boss music triggers
Performance: maintains 60fps on mid-tier hardware (GTX 1060 equivalent) at 1080p medium settings
